title: Thacker Pass Air Permit Technical Review — Phase 65 Climate review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Climate reporting pack. NDEP's technical review records the emissions estimates, modeling, permitting decisions, and state and federal requirements used for the Thacker Pass air permit.
key_findings: The review documents the technical basis for the air-permitting decision.
It exposes modeling assumptions and expected emissions for later comparison.
Expected emissions and permit modeling are not measured operating emissions.
why_it_matters: Which records move global or program-level climate evidence toward a named exposure, responsible authority, intervention, and measured local result? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It supplies the baseline needed to audit later test and monitoring data.
ftfn_relevance: Adds the model and assumptions behind the permit.
Supports later variance checks against measured emissions.
Preserves forecast, limit, and observation as separate evidence stages.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The review predates later construction and operating performance.
It does not establish current permit status, compliance, production, or local outcomes.
